items.h: Matthew Stafford Losing Fantasy Value While Teammates are Injured
items.s: Los Angeles Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford is losing fantasy football value as the offensive skill players around him miss time with injuries. Wide receiver Davante Adams (hamstring) has been out for several weeks, and now wideout Puka Nacua (knee, turf toe) is going to miss time too. Not many proven pass catchers are left for the Rams, so that makes Stafford a riskier fantasy starting option until he gets at least one of the wideouts back. Stafford also has just two touchdowns and 385 passing yards across the past two games combined, while also throwing two interceptions, so he's trending down for lack of production of late too. Most fantasy owners will still start Stafford due to a…

items.h: Matthew Stafford tosses one touchdown, one interception in win
items.s: Matthew Stafford completed 26 of 43 passes for 228 yards in Sunday's win against the Commanders. He also threw one touchdown and one interception while adding one rush for one yard. Stafford hyper-targeted standout wide receiver, Puka Nacua, who accounted for 150 of Stafford's 228 passing yards. Stafford and the Rams play the Cardinals in Week 10, but his value may take a hit of Nacua (knee) misses time.

items.h: Just one TD in Week 9 win
items.s: Stafford completed 26 of 43 passes for 228 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 20-13 win over the Commanders. He added one yard on his only carry. The veteran QB looked the way of Puka Nacua (knee) early and often, with no other Ram pass catcher managing more than 20 receiving yards, and the star wideout was on the other end of a seven-yard TD toss in the fourth quarter that proved to be the winning score. Stafford has thrown a single touchdown pass in back-to-back games after producing multiple TDs in five of six contests before that, and his options could get even thinner with Nacua headed for an MRI after getting hurt on L.A.'s final possession.

items.h: Matthew Stafford links up with a leaping Puka Nacua for a TD
Matthew Stafford Remains a Strong QB1 Option Against Washington
items.s: Los Angeles Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford has maintained QB1 value despite the absence of Davante Adams (hamstring), and he should continue to rank as a top-10 option for Week 9 against the Washington Commanders. Although the veteran quarterback hasn't had one of his primary receivers available, he has still been able to produce at a high level for fantasy football thanks to his advanced passing skills and a supporting cast headlined by superstar Puka Nacua. The 38-year-old routinely gets the Rams into scoring position, and he's now up to 15 touchdowns this season (plus eight turnovers). It seems unlikely that he'll replicate last season's QB3 finish, but he is still the QB10 in…

items.h: Matthew Stafford (elbow) good to go for Sunday
items.s: Matthew Stafford (elbow) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Washington Commanders. As expected, Stafford's elbow injury is nothing serious at this point and won't prevent him from playing on Sunday. He should be good to go, although he is harder to trust starting on a week-to-week basis now with several key pass catchers sidelined due to injury for the Rams.

items.h: Matthew Stafford (elbow) logs full practice Thursday
items.s: Matthew Stafford was a full participant in practice on Thursday. Stafford was reported to be dealing with elbow soreness. He should be a full-go for Sunday's game against the Commanders.

items.h: Practices fully Wednesday
items.s: Stafford (right elbow) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Sarah Barshop of ESPN reports. Stafford was seen leaving the locker room with his upper right arm wrapped in ice after this past Sunday's win against the Chargers. Head coach Sean McVay told Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register on Monday that Stafford has been tending to arm soreness, but the quarterback clarified the situation with Gary Klein of the Los Angeles Times on Wednesday, stating that he's had his right arm wrapped in ice regularly this season. An uncapped session to begin Week 9 prep puts Stafford in the clear to continue to lead the Ram's offense Sunday in Washington.

items.h: Matthew Stafford Practices in Full on Wednesday
items.s: Los Angeles Rams veteran quarterback Matthew Stafford (elbow) was listed as a full participant in practice on Wednesday after he was seen with an ice pack on his right elbow following Sunday's Week 8 win over the Los Angeles Chargers, according to Pro Football Talk. "I'm 38 years old, trying to keep up with these young bucks. Little bit of soreness and stuff that is not uncommon this time of year," Stafford said, via Gary Klein of the Los Angeles Times. "Haven't missed a rep. Feel good. So I'm not too worried about it." It is worth noting after Stafford had surgery on the same elbow during the 2022 offseason. The reigning MVP only attempted 25 passes and threw for just 157 yards with one…

items.h: Managing arm soreness
items.s: Stafford left the locker room after Sunday's 24-9 win over the Chargers with a bag of ice wrapped on his right arm, and Rams coach Sean McVay acknowledged Monday that the quarterback has been dealing with some arm soreness, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports. McVay added that he'll defer to Stafford on the topic of how he's feeling ahead of this weekend's game against the Commanders. In any case, the Rams will issue their first injury report of the week Wednesday, at which point it'll become clear if the QB's arm issue impacts his practice reps.

items.h: Matthew Stafford dealing with elbow soreness
items.s: Rams coach Sean McVay told reporters Matthew Stafford has been dealing with soreness in his right elbow. McVay left the locker room on Sunday with a bag of ice wrapped to his right arm. He will need to be monitored in practice this week.

items.h: Matthew Stafford Dealing With Some Elbow Soreness
items.s: Los Angeles Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford (elbow) left the locker room after Sunday's 24-9 win over the Los Angeles Chargers with a bag of ice wrapped around his right elbow, according to Adam Grosbard of the Los Angeles Daily News. Head coach Sean McVay said that Stafford has dealt with some soreness in the arm, but he deferred to Stafford on how he is feeling. It is something that RotoBaller will be keeping tabs on throughout the week, but we doubt that it is an injury that will keep the 38-year-old future Hall of Famer from suiting up this Sunday against the Washington Commanders in Week 9. Do not be surprised if Stafford is rested during the practice week. After a strong start to…

items.h: Week 8 winners and losers: Burrow, Higgins, Chase steal the show; Falcons falter
items.s: Joe Burrow, Bhayshul Tuten and Brock Bowers came up big in Week 8, while Bijan Robinson, Ashton Jeanty and Jonathan Taylor had quiet days.

items.h: Matthew Stafford scores one touchdown in win Sunday
items.s: Matthew Stafford completed 17-of-25 passing attempts for 157 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in Sunday's 24-9 win over the Los Angeles Chargers. Stafford wasn't able to put up big numbers on the stat sheet on Sunday. He racked up just 157 yards and one touchdown over the course of the game, and he also had an interception that worked against him. He is not as strong of a fantasy option with Davante Adams (hamstring) set to be out of the lineup for a while.

items.h: Subdued performance in Week 8 win
items.s: Stafford completed 17 of 25 passes for 157 yards with one touchdown and one interception in the Rams' 24-9 win over the Chargers on Sunday. Stafford didn't have to take on too much with his team's defense largely keeping a still-reeling Chargers offense at bay. The veteran signal-caller finished with his second-lowest passing yardage total of the season, while his pass-attempt tally tied the season-low figure he'd generated back in Week 1 in Melbourne, Australia, against the Rams. However, Stafford extended his streak of games with at least one TD pass to four when he connected with Puka Nacua from 18 yards out with 3:41 remaining in the third quarter. Stafford will look to continue…

items.h: Matthew Stafford Surges Into Week 8 as a Top-12 Fantasy Option
items.s: Los Angeles Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford continues to rank as a mid-to-low QB1 option for Sunday's Week 8 matchup against the Los Angeles Chargers. Even after losing Davante Adams (hamstring) to injured reserve, the Rams' passing offense has continued to operate at a high level. Much of the credit belongs to superstar receiver Puka Nacua, but Stafford has also benefitted from throwing to his tight ends, running backs, and other wide receivers. Over the last three weeks, the reigning MVP has 800 passing yards, eight touchdowns, and just one turnover. He ranks as the overall QB11 in scoring this season, and he remains a strong option for Week 8. The only red flag worth considering here…

items.h: Three-TD day in Week 7 win
items.s: Stafford completed 23 of 29 passes for 195 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and rushed three times for minus-3 yards in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Raiders on Sunday. Stafford was operating with a less-than-100-percent Puka Nacua (calf) and without Davante Adams (IR, hamstring), so his reduced passing yardage total wasn't entirely surprising. The reigning MVP still found a way to deliver a highly useful fantasy performance via a trio of first-half scoring strikes to Davis Allen (three, five yards) and Nacua (11 yards). Stafford also extended a streak of games with better than a 74.0 percent completion rate to three, and his 79.3 percent tally Sunday was a season-high…

items.h: Matthew Stafford tosses three touchdowns in Week 7 win over Raiders
items.s: Matthew Stafford completed 23-of-29 pass attempts for 195 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception in the Rams' 35-21 Week 7 win over the Las Vegas Raiders. Stafford continues an impactful stretch behind center, passing for two or more touchdowns in five of his last six contests. The veteran signal-caller remains a reliable option behind center for head coach Sean McVay ahead of a Week 8 matchup against the Los Angeles Chargers.

items.h: Matthew Stafford Could Enter Week 7 Without Top Two Targets
items.s: Los Angeles Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford has been a very strong fantasy football option for most of the 2026 season, but his floor and ceiling could take a massive hit in Week 7 if he has to play without both of his top two wide receivers. Davante Adams (hamstring) is already on injured reserve and will miss an extended period of time, while Puka Nacua (calf) is listed as questionable after missing Friday's practice entirely. Nacua is trending in the wrong direction, but we'll get more information on his availability when the Rams post their list of inactive players 90 minutes before kickoff. If Nacua can't play, managers should consider starting someone other than Stafford this week.…

items.h: Matthew Stafford throws two touchdowns in loss Sunday
items.s: Matthew Stafford completed 25-of-33 passing attempts for 222 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals. Stafford looked pretty good on Sunday. He threw for over 200 yards and two touchdowns over the course of the afternoon, but that wasn't enough for the Rams, as they still put up just 16 points and suffered a loss at the hands of the Cardinals. Stafford should continue to be a relevant fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

items.h: Two more TD passes in Week 6
items.s: Stafford was 25-for-33 passing for 222 yards, two touchdowns and no interceptions during Sunday's 18-16 defeat against the Cardinals. Stafford's streak of outings with at least 300 yards passing came to a close at four games, but he offset it with his fourth performance with multiple TD passes through the first six weeks of the season. With the Rams sitting at 2-4 and seeking to right the ship, he does have a get-right game on paper next Sunday in Las Vegas, and he has several talented skill-position players at his disposal, though star wideout Davante Adams exited on the Rams' second-to-last-offensive play of the game Sunday with what may have been a knee injury. However, the team didn't…

items.h: Matthew Stafford a Must-Start in Potential Shootout
items.s: Los Angeles Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford has ranked near the top of the fantasy football leaderboard in three of his last four games, and he should continue to produce at a very high level in Week 6 against the Arizona Cardinals. Stafford is coming off a 383-yard, three-touchdown performance against the Bills, during which he also completed a career-high 40 passes. He should continue to throw the ball very often in Week 6, given that this game has an implied total of 51.5 points. Furthermore, Arizona has allowed the most points in the NFL this season, with 32.4 points surrendered per game. The Cardinals have also given up the third-most fantasy points to opposing quarterbacks in 2026.…

items.h: Matthew Stafford throws three TDs in Week 5 loss
items.s: Matthew Stafford completed 40 of his 54 pass attempts for 383 yards and three touchdowns in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5. Stafford turned in a huge game in the Monday night loss to Buffalo, but he couldn't put any points on the board in overtime. The veteran quarterback threw two touchdown passes to Davante Adams, while his third went to Puka Nacua. Stafford has now thrown for 1,572 yards, nine touchdowns, and six interceptions through five games. He will be a solid QB1 in fantasy in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

items.h: Massive yardage total in OT loss
items.s: Stafford completed 40 of 54 passes for 383 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions in the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night. Stafford's stellar final line underscores he did everything within his power to lead the Rams to victory, as the reigning MVP finished with his second-highest passing yardage total of the season and fourth 300-yard effort of the campaign. The night also marked Stafford's third multi-TD tally over the first five games, with his scoring strikes going to Davante Adams (four and five yards) and Puka Nacua (two yards). Nacua also was on the receiving end of a whopping 17 of Stafford's completions and the intended target on 24 of his pass…

items.h: Matthew Stafford's Huge Effort Comes Up Short in Week 5
items.s: Los Angeles Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford completed 40 of his 54 pass attempts for 383 passing yards, three passing touchdowns, and zero interceptions during Monday's Week 5 loss against the Buffalo Bills in overtime. He also took one sack along the way. Stafford put up a valiant effort against the Bills, setting a new career-high for completions in a single game. A late touchdown pass forced overtime, and Stafford got the Rams in position to win the game with an overtime field goal, but the kick was no good. Stafford now has nine touchdowns over his last four games, and Monday also represented his first game this season without an interception. Even though the 38-year-old doesn't have…

items.h: Matthew Stafford Has a Great Opportunity to Bounce Back Against Buffalo
items.s: Los Angeles Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford is coming off a disappointing performance against the Philadelphia Eagles in Week 4, but he has a great opportunity to bounce back during Monday Night Football against the Buffalo Bills in Week 5. It has been shocking to see Stafford's points decline when Puka Nacua is healthy, as the veteran quarterback has not yet thrown a touchdown pass in a game where Nacua has been on the field this season. With that being said, he has still managed to throw for at least 315 yards in each of his last three games. Plus, the touchdown-less pattern could just be a fluke, with travel to blame in Week 1 and weather to blame in Week 4. We like Stafford's chances…

items.h: Stafford completed 32 of 51 passes for 317 yards, no touchdowns and two interceptions in Sunday's 24-20 win over the Eagles. He also rushed three times for 10 yards.
items.s: Stafford was picked off twice in the first half as the Rams took a 20-10 deficit into the locker room. The veteran QB didn't throw a touchdown pass in the return of top target Puka Nacua (hip) from a two-game absence, but Stafford led a pair of fourth-quarter touchdown drives culminating in Kyren Williams rushing scores as the Rams produced 14 unanswered points in the final four minutes to improve to 2-2. Stafford takes an underwhelming 6:6 TD:INT into a Week 5 home game against the Bills.

items.h: Stafford completed 30 of 55 passes for 390 yards, two touchdowns and two interceptions in Sunday's 30-26 loss to the Broncos. He also rushed twice for 13 yards.
items.s: Stafford guided the Rams to a 16-0 halftime lead courtesy of a five-yard touchdown pass to Tyler Higbee followed by three Harrison Mevis field goals. LA's lead was erased in the third quarter, and after retaking the lead in the fourth, Stafford threw a disastrous pick-six that Talanoa Hufanga took 66 yards to the house to give the Broncos their first lead with 4:49 remaining. That pick-six was the 33rd Stafford has thrown in his regular-season career, surpassing Brett Favre for sole possession of first place in that dubious stat. Stafford was unfazed by that mistake and responded with a…

items.h: Stafford completed 22 of 31 passes for 327 yards with four touchdowns and one interception and rushed four times for minus-1 yard in the Rams' 28-6 win over the Giants on Monday night.
items.s: Stafford shrugged off the absence of No. 1 receiver Puka Nacua (hip), delivering a stellar and nearly mistake-free performance while focusing heavily on Davante Adams, who was on the receiving end of half of the veteran signal-caller's touchdown passes. Stafford averaged 10.5 yards per attempt overall, and his scoring strikes came from 31 and 11 yards out to Adams, and from 10 and five yards on connections with Kyren Williams and Terrance Ferguson, respectively. Stafford has a thorny Week 3 assignment on tap irrespective of Nacua's availability, however, considering the Rams will pay a visit…
